Bug_Title: USELESS_STRING: Invocation of toString on an array (DMI_INVOKING_TOSTRING_ON_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
The code invokes toString on an array, which will generate a fairly useless result
such as [C@16f0472. Consider using Arrays.toString to convert the array into a readable
String that gives the contents of the array. See Programming Puzzlers, chapter 3, puzzle 12.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by invoking the toString method directly on an integer array. This results in a useless string representation such as [I@16f0472, instead of a meaningful representation of the array's contents.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the `showBug` method with an integer array. The method incorrectly uses `array.toString()` which returns a useless string representation of the array. The test asserts that the result should be the string representation of the array contents, causing the test to fail.
